find: if (w >= 3 && h >= 3 && cells.length === w * h) return { mass: cells.length };
replace: // a filled rectangle is not read as a mass
why: The read-back has no mass: a filled rectangle falls through to `other`, so the sweep's RUN LENGTHS block reports every mass as a shape `runs` never draws and states no mass-size distribution, and the mass-shape test can no longer tell a mass from two that merged.
killedBy: the mass read-back (issue #1066) reads a filled rectangle at least three cells each way as a mass, and a hollow ring or a slab two cells thick as other
